observation: ZN-E001 (masked pooling on the CPMLP encoder) broke the ZN-E000 collapse: MAPE 0.3451, Acc@15 0.3405, RMSE 456 (pred SD 101 vs target SD 407, corr 0.26). Main limit: long-life cells are underpredicted (500-1000: MAPE 0.616, bias -511; >1000: MAPE 0.863, bias -1071; Acc@15 0 on all 5 cells >500). User rule 2026-11-08: no CPMLP-family candidates in v6.
primary_hypothesis: A first non-CPMLP family that reads curve shape with a residual Conv1D encoder (local V/I/Q inflections instead of one flat Linear over 900 values) and models fade dynamics with a masked causal dilated TCN (receptive field 127 > 100 cycles), followed by the masked mean/last/delta summary that fixed the collapse, separates long-life cells: >700-cycle MAPE below 0.764 and overall MAPE below 0.3371 (ZN-E001 - 0.008) or Acc@15 above 0.3605.
question_inherited: Can a non-CPMLP mask-safe architecture keep the collapse fix and reduce long-life underprediction on ZN-coin?
unresolved_from_reference: Whether the long-life underprediction is a representation limit of the flat per-cycle MLP / lack of temporal modelling, or a loss/data-imbalance limit (15 of 20 val cells <500 cycles).
why_this_experiment: User excludes CPMLP; this opens the first new family (family reference run). architecture.md §3: missing temporal trend -> dilated causal TCN; curve inflection loss -> Conv1D curve encoder; §4 mask contract kept (causal padding, masked pooling, last observed index). Keeps the one mechanism proven in ZN-E001 (masked summary).
modification: New family reference: Curve Encoder = Conv1D stem (3->32->64->64, strides 2) + 2 residual curve blocks + avg pool -> [B,100,64]; Degradation Encoder = 6 masked causal depthwise-separable TCN blocks (dilations 1..32, GroupNorm, residual) + masked mean/last/last-first summary -> Linear(192->64); Head = 4 MLP blocks (d_ff 128) + Linear(64->1).
changed_components: Whole family vs ZN-E001 (curve encoder MLP -> residual Conv1D; added masked causal TCN). This is a new-family reference run, not a single-mechanism follow-up; later follow-ups change one mechanism at a time against this run (architecture.md §5).
held_constant_components: Masked mean/last/delta summary, Relative Huber delta 0.15, Adam lr 5e-4, batch 128, seed 2021, split 2021, A2-ZN epoch rule, data and preprocessing.
controlled_variables: Split 2021 and training seed 2021, minimum 5 / maximum 100 epochs, patience 5 after epoch 5, diagnostics every 50 steps.
expected_evidence: Overall MAPE/Acc@15/RMSE vs ZN-E001; EOL-band MAPE and bias (500-1000, >1000); prediction SD/target SD and correlation; gradient ratios per block; padding sensitivity; params/time.
rejection_condition: DISCARD if MAPE is not below 0.3371 and Acc@15 not above 0.3605 vs ZN-E001, or predictions collapse (SD < 10% target SD), or long-life MAPE does not improve. Invalid under the usual protocol/finite/epoch checks.
minimum_evidence_requirements: At least five complete epochs; finite MAPE, Acc@15, MAE, and RMSE from one checkpoint; sample and unique-cell counts for every domain; gradient, update, activation, prediction, mask, and compute diagnostics.
required_diagnostics: Epoch learning curve; selected and minimum-MAPE epochs; CPMLP block gradients and updates; activation health; prediction spread and bias; prefix, domain, and EOL errors; domain guardrail flags; padding sensitivity; parameters, memory, time, and throughput.

architecture_addendum.responsible_stage: Curve Encoder + Degradation Encoder (new family reference)
architecture_addendum.mechanism: Residual Conv1D curve encoder + masked causal dilated TCN + masked summary pooling
architecture_addendum.evidence: ZN-E001 long-life underprediction (Acc@15 0 for >500 cycles) with flat per-cycle MLP and no temporal model; user excludes CPMLP
architecture_addendum.shapes: [B,100,3,300] -> reshape [B*100,3,300] -> Conv stem [B*100,64,38] -> 2 residual blocks -> avgpool [B,100,64] -> TCN x6 [B,64,100] -> masked summary [B,192] -> Linear [B,64] -> 4 MLP blocks -> head [B,1]
architecture_addendum.mask_path: curve features multiplied by mask before TCN; causal left padding only (no future slots); output re-masked after each block; mean over mask==1, last at mask.sum()-1, delta = last - cycle1
architecture_addendum.expected_evidence: MAPE, RMSE, Acc@15, DB-MAPE vs ZN-E001 and paper (CPMLP 0.558/0.297, CPTransformer 0.515/0.202); EOL-band errors; pred/target SD; gradient ratio
